paper_title: Constraining Axion-Like Particles with HAWC Observations of TeV Blazars
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (y-axis plotted in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1; multiplier applied)
notes: Astrophysical bound from HAWC/ACT observations of stacked TeV blazars via ALP-photon mixing. Main result: g_agamma > ~3e-11 GeV^-1 excluded at >3 sigma for ALP masses below ~200-300 neV (3e-7 eV). Encoded as an approximately flat horizontal exclusion line. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumption. Exclusion stated at >3 sigma level (not standard 90/95% CL); 0.95 chosen as nearest option.
